items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: Peter Patton, he would get plenty of weight too.

ctx.x: Yeah, but then after Clem it was Kelly?

Well, after I got to Kelly, well I was probably stuck with Kelly, because he had lots of weight. And he was better than I was. I was getting plenty of weight myself, and I had a bar playing band, and we used to get lots of weight. Peter Patton, he would get plenty of weight too. Well, we had to, maybe if we'd get a job, we had to approach each other. Mm-hmm. I had to approach each other. Oh, you all used to get jobs, huh? Yeah. Who else was in that band then? Oh man, I couldn't call him, man. That band would…

That band would change so much. Well, did Kelly have a band before you came into it? I mean, he had a band before he used you, he must use somebody else I'm crying at. Do you remember whose place you took in the band? No, I don't remember.
